title: Sanctimonious Cromwell and his ironsides that put the women and children of Drogheda to the sword with the bible text God is love pasted round the mouth of his cannon?
html_source: Oliver Cromwell brutally conquered most of Ireland with his New Model Army in battles that took place from 1649-53. The Siege of Drogheda was an early victory and he may have been more brutal than elsewhere, wanting the carnage to be a warning to the Catholic citizenry that he (and thus Puritanism) was divinely sanctioned.
